bio: Nic Long First-Year Social Committee Ivy Yard Hello Everyone! My name is Nic Long and I’m originally from South Hadley, MA! I am currently a first year in Holworthy middle hoping to concentrate in History and Science. I’m super excited to foster a welcoming and vibrant environment through FYSC! Outside of FYSC, I am also a part of AAA (the Asian American Association and FIMRC). You can usually find me either at Gong Cha or sitting in the yard studying. I’m always down to have conversations so please feel free to say hi or reach out with any questions!
